{{Current events|year=2021|month=12|day=29|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021 Somali political crisis]]
**[[Somali Armed Forces|Troops]] loyal to [[List of prime ministers of Somalia|Prime Minister]] [[Mohamed Hussein Roble]] gather outside the [[Villa Somalia|presidential palace]] in the capital [[Mogadishu]] after [[President of Somalia|President]] [[Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed]] tried to suspend the Prime Minister in what has been described as an attempted [[self-coup]]. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/world/africa/2021/12/29/hundreds-of-troops-loyal-to-somalia-pm-gather-outside-presidential-palace/ (''The National'')]
*[[War in Darfur]]
**A night [[curfew]] is imposed in [[North Darfur]], [[Sudan]], after armed groups [[looting|looted]] and burned a [[United Nations]] [[World Food Programme]] warehouse and [[United Nations–African Union Mission in Darfur|UNAMID]] facilities in [[Al-Fashir]], stealing around 1,900 tonnes of food. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/curfew-imposed-sudans-north-darfur-after-militias-loot-un-food-stores-2021-12-29/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Three people are killed and four others are injured in a fire at a [[Candlelight vigil|candlelit vigil]] in [[Kosiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-59820248 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 208,099 new cases of [[COVID-19]], which is also the highest daily total recorded in any European nation since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://www.leparisien.fr/societe/sante/covid-19-en-france-185-nouveaux-deces-le-nombre-de-patients-hospitalises-ne-cesse-de-grimper-29-12-2021-DAWK6RXNVZC2XH27EOWEQXUCUU.php (''Le Parisien'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 28,828 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,134,713. [https://greekreporter.com/2021/12/29/covid-19-cases-greece/ (Greek Reporter)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****Despite the number of new cases caused by the Omicron variant reaching a record 98,030 cases, [[Italy]] completely lifts the mandatory quarantine for those who received [[COVID-19 vaccine]] [[booster shot]] and reduces it to five days for the vaccinated people whose most recent dose was more than 120 days before exposure. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-12-29/italy-set-to-ease-covid-isolation-rules-as-omicron-cases-surge (Bloomberg)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malta]]
****[[Malta]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 1,337 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 49,625. [https://www.independent.com.mt/articles/2021-12-29/local-news/Malta-hits-yet-another-Covid-record-1-337-new-cases-reported-6736239407 (''The Malta Independent'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****Despite the number of cases caused by the Omicron variant reaching a record high, [[Spain]] reduces the isolation period for people who test positive for COVID-19 and the mandatory [[quarantine]] for people who had close contact with someone who tested positive to seven days due to staffing shortages and disruptions in some industries. [https://news.trust.org/item/20211229160744-b02xv/ (Thomson Reuters Foundation)]
****Spain reports for the first time more than 100,000 cases of COVID-19 in one day. [https://www.elperiodico.com/es/sanidad/20211229/espana-supera-cien-mil-casos-covid-record-contagios-13042094 (''El Periódico'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 183,037 new cases of COVID-19. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/covid-cases-latest-uk-omicron-b1984021.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
****[[Australia]] reports a record for the ninth consecutive day of 18,243 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 341,437. [[COVID-19 pandemic in Victoria|Victoria]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in New South Wales|New South Wales]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Queensland|Queensland]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in South Australia|South Australia]] and [[COVID-19 pandemic in Tasmania|Tasmania]] all report record numbers of new cases. [https://covidlive.com.au/ (COVID-LIVE)] [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-03-17/coronavirus-cases-data-reveals-how-covid-19-spreads-in-australia/12060704 (ABC News Australia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
****[[New Zealand]] reports its first community exposure of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in a fully-vaccinated man who travelled from the [[United Kingdom]] to [[Auckland]] on December 16. [https://i.stuff.co.nz/national/health/300487986/covid19-omicron-border-case-active-in-the-community-is-dj-dimension (Stuff)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia]]
****The [[Tunisia]]n Health Ministry authorizes the use of the [[Russia]]n [[Sputnik Light]] vaccine as a [[booster dose]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tunisia-approves-russias-sputnik-light-vaccine-booster-2021-12-29/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Zambia]]
****[[Zambia]] reports a record 5,255 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 243,638. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/zambia-registers-record-number-of-daily-covid-19-cases/2461165 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
***[[Argentina]] surpasses 5.5 million cases of COVID-19 after reporting a record 42,032 new cases in the past 24 hours. [https://www.ambito.com/informacion-general/coronavirus/covid-19-record-la-argentina-42032-nuevos-casos-24-horas-n5343708 (Ámbito)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Mexico]]
***The [[Mexico|Mexican]] health regulatory authority [[Federal Commission for the Protection against Sanitary Risk|COFEPRIS]] approves the emergency use of the [[Cuba]]n-made Abdala [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.jornada.com.mx/notas/2021/12/29/politica/cofepris-autoriza-la-vacuna-cubana-abdala/ (''Le Jornada'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Belarus–Russia relations]]
**[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] and [[President of Belarus|Belarusian President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] announce that [[Belarus]] and [[Russia]] will hold [[Military exercise|war games]] early next year. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/russia-and-belarus-to-hold-joint-war-games-early-next-year/2021/12/29/536847f2-68cc-11ec-9390-eae241f4c8b1_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*A [[Law of Russia|Russian law]] requiring foreign travellers and [[Migrant worker|migrant workers]] to undergo mandatory medical checks, including [[Blood test|blood tests]] and [[X-ray|X-rays]], and submit fingerprints and [[Biometrics|biometric data]] enters into force. [https://www.dw.com/en/russia-introduces-mandatory-medical-checks-for-foreigners/a-60285732 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Hong Kong national security law]]
**Pro-democracy digital media website ''[[Stand News]]'' shuts down in [[Hong Kong]] as police raids its offices and arrest senior executives. The senior executives are later charged with [[sedition]] in the latest crackdown related to the national security law. The Hong Kong government says that the news site's assets have been frozen and that more arrests could occur. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/zinnialee/2021/12/29/hong-kong-pro-democracy-news-site-shuts-down-after-national-security-police-arrest-executives-and-freeze-assets/?sh=48b3980210b2 (''Forbes'')]
*[[British people|British]] [[socialite]] [[Ghislaine Maxwell]], an associate of [[Jeffrey Epstein]], is found guilty of [[sex trafficking]] by a [[court]] in [[New York City]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/jury-reaches-verdict-trial-jeffrey-epstein-associate-ghislaine/story?id=81863373 (ABC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*A team of [[Greeks|Greek]] divers led by Kostas Thoctarides announce the discovery of the wreck of the [[Italian submarine Jantina (1932)|Italian submarine ''Jantina'']] south of [[Mykonos]] in the [[Aegean Sea]]. The [[submarine]] was sunk on July 5, 1941, after being torpedoed by the British submarine [[HMS Torbay (N79)|HMS ''Torbay'']]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/greek-divers-discover-italian-world-war-two-submarine-wreck-2021-12-29/ (Reuters)]
